texts.CorporateHub_Reminder_BreachTitle: Breach {0}: report to the authority by {1}, or record why not
texts.CorporateHub_Reminder_Body: Open the record to see what to do. Reminder settings are in BarnCRM Settings, Corporate Hub.
texts.CorporateHub_Policy_RequestBody: Open the policy and read it, then press I Have Read This on the Corporate Hub page.
texts.CorporateHub_Policy_NotAskable: Only an Active document with Needs Acknowledgment checked can be sent for acknowledgment.
texts.CorporateHub_Policy_NotOpen: This request is no longer open.
texts.CorporateHub_Policy_NoPermission: You need the Manage Corporate Hub permission (in Corporate Hub Admin) to do this.
texts.CorporateHub_Error_Generic: Corporate Hub could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.CorporateHub_Home_Intro: Policies you are asked to read, compliance obligations due in the next 60 days and agreements whose notice or end date falls in the next 90.
texts.CorporateHub_Home_NoObligations: Nothing due in the next 60 days.
texts.CorporateHub_Home_NoAgreements: No agreement needs a decision in the next 90 days.
texts.CorporateHub_Home_TemplatesAdded: {0} templates added. Obligations arrive Off, policies and processing activities Draft: review them with your counsel before use.

texts.CorporateHub_Board_Giving: {0}% of current members gave this fiscal year.

texts.CorporateHub_Board_Assessed: Self-assessment started. Members answer in the board portal, or staff enter their answers.
